response.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS overall_average FROM station_averages) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_bandwidth_usage - o.overall_average AS difference FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_bandwidth_usage > o.overall_average ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10;
